headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 15, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals' pitching woes continue as right-handed pitcher Nick Mears has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. The Boston Red Sox have bolstered their roster with the acquisition of outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade with the Detroit Tigers.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups and rotations. Nick Mears (Kansas City Royals) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement, while Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles) has been moved to the 60-day injured list with left elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Chris Martin (Texas Rangers), Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds), William Kempner (Miami Marlins), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), and Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves).

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, shaking up the MLB landscape. The Boston Red Sox acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for a Player To Be Named Later. The Kansas City Royals acquired right-handed pitcher Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash, while the Baltimore Orioles acquired right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros.

top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Nick Mears has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Jahmai Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade. The details of the deal, which was announced on July 14, 2026, include the Red Sox sending a Player To Be Named Later to the Detroit Tigers in exchange for Jones.
